hooks.command: uv run ruff check .; R1=$?; uv run mypy backend/; R2=$?; uv run pytest tests/ -q 2>&1; R3=$?; if [ $R1 -ne 0 ] || [ $R2 -ne 0 ] || [ $R3 -ne 0 ]; then echo '{"continue":false,"stopReason":"Quality gate failed — fix errors above, then retry."}'; exit 2; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Running quality gate: lint + types + tests...

hooks.command: FILE=$(tr "," "\n" | grep file_path | grep -oE "[a-zA-Z0-9._/-]+.py" | head -1); case "$FILE" in *.py) uv run ruff check --fix "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; true;; esac
